Yūki Kaji (Japanese: 梶裕貴 Kaji Yūki) is a Japanese voice actor for . 

==Biography==
Kaji was born in , on September 3, 1985 and became a voice actor and singer as an adult. Kaji began to provide voices for near the end of , where he portrayed Pokémon rescuer Virgil. Shortly afterwards, he gained more prominent roles in , playing , one of , and the nicknamed Squishy and Z2. Kaji is currently affiliated with the talent group VIMS.
